messages.content: ami consistent post korchi but growth stagnant, ki wrong hote pare
Consistency good sign, but content quality ba format e kono variation try korcho recently?
na, same format e cholchi shuru theke
That could be part of it - audiences and algorithms both respond to some freshness over time. Notun format ekta try koro, dekho ki response ashe.
kirokom notun format try korte pari suggest korবে?

Specific suggestion amar pokkhe difficult niche na জেনে, but general idea - jodi always talking-head video koro, ekta behind-the-scenes ba Q&A format try koro. Variety audience ke fresh feeling dey without changing your core identity.
